highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with current upstream bug fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can now select a different face when fontconfig offers a closer match. Use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface where text metrics and glyph selection must remain deterministic.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries fontconfig's direct match before the previous sorted fallback path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Specify the family and style explicitly, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and includes the current upstream Chrome m153 bug-fix sync.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its current upstream bug fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It also includes the current upstream Chrome m153 bug-fix sync. Linux applications that rely on exact fallback font selection should use an explicit or bundled typeface.
